author: SnowSX3
body:
Reported Player(s):  Official_Neesa
Rules Broken: A2
"...rudeness and excessive swearing is strictly not allowed."

Evidence: http://imgur.com/ap2X2q6,wKMqCFH,IrllQlC#0
(Three images are on the link.)

This player was being rude after killing other players.
Vulgar swearing was used.
Even after receiving been warned about it they didn't care.

This player has just come off a 2-day temp ban for the same reason. (Rudeness)
It has only been a few days and now, this player has re-offended, like the temp-ban meant nothing to them.
This player also has 15 infractions and all of them are chat-related.
These infractions consist of:
6 warns,
6 kicks,
3 temp-bans.

This player has all of these infractions and continues to be offensive in the chat with no thought of changing in the near future.

Cheers.
